title: A person became an agent Party's sponsor (OP-154 m.3 (e))
description: The member of the SET `events` claim, and of the CloudEvent `data.events`, under `urn:suiss:access:event:agent.sponsor_assigned`. A notification, never an authority source: losing or delaying it changes no decision (INV-24).

access_position.description: The event's monotone version field (OP-22): it only grows within its source, the domain for an authority event and the issuer for an identity event. A receiver that has applied a later or equal position re-queries instead of applying this event.
